sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》周日版。

sentences.en: If you don't already know who Bad Bunny is, by this time next week, you definitely will.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不知道“坏痞兔”（Bad Bunny）是谁，下周这个时候，你肯定会知道的。

sentences.en: At the Grammys tonight, he's up for six awards and that's already made history.
sentences.zh: 在今晚的格莱美奖上，他获得了六项提名，这已经创造了历史。

sentences.en: He's the first Spanish-language artist up for album, song, and record of the year simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 他是首位同时入围年度专辑、年度歌曲和年度制作的西班牙语歌手。

sentences.en: But tonight is really just an appetizer for the massive moment he's about to have.
sentences.zh: 但今晚对他即将迎来的高光时刻来说，仅仅是个开胃菜。

sentences.en: One week from today, Bad Bunny headlines the biggest stage in music, the Super Bowl halftime show.
sentences.zh: 一周后的今天，坏痞兔将登上音乐界最大的舞台——超级碗中场秀。

sentences.en: And that would be a big deal any year.
sentences.zh: 无论哪一年，这都是一件大事。

sentences.en: But this year, it's become incredibly contentious.
sentences.zh: 但今年，这件事变得极具争议。

sentences.en: Because Bad Bunny has been openly critical of ICE and its immigration crackdown.
sentences.zh: 因为坏痞兔一直公开批评美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）及其移民打压政策。

sentences.en: Back in September, when this was first announced, conservative commentators were not thrilled about it.
sentences.zh: 早在九月份，当这个消息刚宣布时，保守派评论员们就对此感到不满。

sentences.en: The NFL just chose the Bad Bunny rabbit or whatever his name, this guy who hates ICE.
sentences.zh: NFL竟然选了坏痞兔还是什么乱七八糟名字的家伙，这个讨厌ICE的家伙。

sentences.en: The white, guilt-ridden, virtue-signaling NFL announcing Puerto Rican Trump-hating rapper Bad Bunny will be the Super Bowl halftime show.
sentences.zh: 那个充满白人负罪感、只会搞美德信号的NFL，竟然宣布波多黎各的、讨厌特朗普的饶舌歌手坏痞兔将担任超级碗中场秀嘉宾。

sentences.en: Don't be mad that we have a cross-dresser who doesn't speak English doing the halftime show.
sentences.zh: 别因为我们找了个不会说英语的异装癖来表演中场秀而生气。

sentences.en: Because if Kamala won, he would have been a cabinet member.
sentences.zh: 因为如果卡玛拉赢了，他可能就是内阁成员了。

sentences.en: And President Trump, who loves football, called the selection of Bad Bunny, quote,
sentences.zh: 而热爱橄榄球的特朗普总统，在谈到选择坏痞兔时，引用了这样的话：

sentences.en: So today, we're going to talk about Bad Bunny.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我们要聊聊坏痞兔。

sentences.en: And with me to do that are the hosts of PopCast, music critic John Caramonica and music reporter Joe Coscarelli.
sentences.zh: 和我一起聊的是《PopCast》的主持人，乐评人约翰·卡拉莫尼卡和音乐记者乔·科斯卡雷利。

sentences.en: It's Sunday, February 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月1日，星期日。

sentences.en: John, Joe, welcome to the Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 约翰、乔，欢迎来到周日版《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Great to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴有你们在。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Oh, this is like a whole new thing.
sentences.zh: 噢，这感觉像是一个全新的节目。

sentences.en: It's a whole new thing.
sentences.zh: 确实是一个全新的节目。

sentences.en: We're loose.
sentences.zh: 我们很放松。

sentences.en: We're loose.
sentences.zh: 我们很放松。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're loose.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们很放松。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so welcome to the Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 好的，欢迎来到周日版《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I think this is the first Daily PopCast crossover event.
sentences.zh: 我想这是《每日新闻》和《PopCast》的首次联动活动。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is the first official.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是第一次正式联动。

sentences.en: John and I have never been on an episode of the Daily together.
sentences.zh: 我和约翰以前从未一起上过《每日新闻》的节目。

sentences.en: Together, right.
sentences.zh: 一起，没错。

sentences.en: We love that.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I want to start by just stipulating that this is the week that Bad Bunny is going to essentially subsume America, culturally speaking.
sentences.zh: 我想先说明一点，这一周坏痞兔将在文化层面上彻底席卷美国。

sentences.en: There's a good chance he will walk away with at least a few big awards at the Grammys,
sentences.zh: 他很有可能在格莱美奖上斩获几项大奖，

sentences.en: and he is going to perform in Spanish in front of America at this critical juncture when this federal immigration crackdown is maybe at its highest point of tension yet.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个联邦移民打压政策矛盾可能达到顶峰的关键时刻，他将要在全美面前用西班牙语表演。

sentences.en: In front of America and the world, I think, which is worth mentioning.
sentences.zh: 我想是在全美乃至全世界面前，这一点值得一提。

sentences.en: I mean, the Super Bowl is one of, if not the biggest and most visible music performances on the planet.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，超级碗是地球上最重要、曝光度最高的音乐表演之一，如果不是唯一的话。

sentences.en: Apologies to the Grammy Awards, which are happening tonight.
sentences.zh: 向今晚举办的格莱美奖致歉。

sentences.en: Salute to them.
sentences.zh: 向他们致敬。

sentences.en: It is a clash between two incredibly vocal people that's about to be set up.
sentences.zh: 这即将成为两个立场鲜明的人之间的冲突。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny, as you say, is never shy about his political opinions, and he's now set up to have a very vocal confrontation with Donald Trump and his many minions.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，坏痞兔从不掩饰自己的政治观点，他现在准备与唐纳德·特朗普及其众多追随者进行一场激烈的交锋。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to first just get into the reason why we have this moment, this moment of a potential clash, this moment where we're all waiting to see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我想先探讨一下我们为什么会迎来这个时刻，这个可能发生冲突的时刻，这个我们都在等待看会发生什么的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think that is really because of who Bad Bunny is and what he's come to represent for tens of millions of people who listen to him.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是因为坏痞兔本人，以及他对于数千万听众所代表的意义。

sentences.en: So let's start there with the basics.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们从基础开始。

sentences.en: Who is he?
sentences.zh: 他是谁？

sentences.en: Who is Bad Bunny?
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔是谁？

sentences.en: Joe?
sentences.zh: 乔？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny comes from small-town Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔来自波多黎各的一个小镇。

sentences.en: He's born Benito Ocasio.
sentences.zh: 他出生时叫贝尼托·奥卡西奥。

sentences.en: He's a kid who grew up on the first and second generations of Puerto Rican reggaeton, which had a huge commercial moment, even in the United States,
sentences.zh: 他是在第一代和第二代波多黎各雷鬼动音乐中成长起来的孩子，这种音乐即使在美国也曾有过巨大的商业成功，

sentences.en: in the late 90s and early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 在90年代末和21世纪初。

sentences.en: I think, if anything, people know the beat from Daddy Yankee's Gasolina.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果说人们知道什么，那就是洋基老爹（Daddy Yankee）的《Gasolina》里的节奏。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Hard to forget.
sentences.zh: 很难忘记。

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: And that was like a seismic moment in American pop culture on the heels of the Latin crossover of the mid to late 90s.
sentences.zh: 那是在90年代中后期拉丁音乐跨界浪潮之后，美国流行文化中一个震撼性的时刻。

sentences.en: You're thinking Ricky Martin, another Puerto Rican superstar.
sentences.zh: 你想到的是瑞奇·马丁，另一位波多黎各巨星。

sentences.en: And then that gets a little harder-edged with reggaeton, which is their version of dance-influenced rap music, known for being provocative, let's say, explicit,
sentences.zh: 然后雷鬼动音乐变得更加硬核，这是他们版本的受舞蹈影响的饶舌音乐，以挑衅性、可以说露骨、

sentences.en: occasionally misogynistic.
sentences.zh: 偶尔带有厌女色彩而闻名。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: In the way that a lot of American rap music has faced similar criticisMs.
sentences.zh: 就像许多美国饶舌音乐也面临过类似的批评一样。

sentences.en: And Bad Bunny shows up, and he's like, no, no, no, no, we're going to do things my way.
sentences.zh: 然后坏痞兔出现了，他说，不，不，不，不，我们要按我的方式来做。

sentences.en: And this starts, as most things do, on the internet.
sentences.zh: 这一切就像大多数事情一样，始于互联网。

sentences.en: He's posting songs on SoundCloud, which is the sort of underground rap platform of the early 2010s.
sentences.zh: 他在SoundCloud上发布歌曲，那是2010年代初的一种地下饶舌平台。

sentences.en: And he's on YouTube, and he's all over social media.
sentences.zh: 他在YouTube上，他在社交媒体上无处不在。

sentences.en: He becomes a colorful Instagram presence.
sentences.zh: 他成为了Instagram上一个色彩鲜明的存在。

sentences.en: And he's pushing what has become a sort of fossilized genre into the 21st century with genre bending, with fashion experimentation.
sentences.zh: 他正在通过流派融合和时尚实验，将一种已经僵化的流派推向21世纪。

sentences.en: He's painting his nails.
sentences.zh: 他涂指甲油。

sentences.en: He's wearing gender-bending clothing.
sentences.zh: 他穿着打破性别的服装。

sentences.en: He has jewelry that might not be the sort of machismo that you're used to in this world.
sentences.zh: 他佩戴的珠宝可能不是这个世界里你习惯的那种大男子主义风格。

sentences.en: He's presenting himself in this kind of socially progressive way, with this aesthetic that doesn't really fit with what we've seen from reggaeton stars thus far.
sentences.zh: 他以一种社会进步的方式展示自己，这种审美与我们迄今为止在雷鬼动明星身上看到的并不相符。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What I will say is, you can't talk about the rise of Bad Bunny without talking about how he dovetails with the rise of streaming platforMs.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，谈论坏痞兔的崛起，就不能不谈他与流媒体平台兴起的契合。

sentences.en: In order to be a Latin star or a Spanish-language music star in the years leading up to that, primarily you're a star of radio.
sentences.zh: 在那之前的几年里，要成为一名拉丁明星或西班牙语音乐明星，你主要是电台明星。

sentences.en: Part of the reason that reggaeton got sort of fossilized or ossified in a way is because people landed on a style that made sense on tropical radio, basically.
sentences.zh: 雷鬼动之所以会僵化或固化，部分原因是人们找到了一种在热带电台听起来合理的风格，基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: Like they knew it would be a hit.
sentences.zh: 就像他们知道这会成为热门歌曲一样。

sentences.en: They knew it would be played on these radio stations.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这些电台会播放它。

sentences.en: And they're working almost from the hits backwards and the formulas of how to make things incredibly successful.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎是从热门歌曲反推，研究如何让作品获得巨大成功的公式。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny arrives.
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔来了。

sentences.en: What do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有什么？

sentences.en: You have YouTube as a successful distribution platform.
sentences.zh: 你有YouTube作为一个成功的发行平台。

sentences.en: You have SoundCloud to post your songs on.
sentences.zh: 你有SoundCloud来发布你的歌曲。

sentences.en: You have Spotify and Apple Music in order to get songs directly out to your listeners without having to navigate a radio infrastructure or even a major label infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 你有Spotify和Apple Music，可以直接将歌曲传达给听众，而无需绕过电台基础设施，甚至无需绕过大型唱片公司基础设施。

sentences.en: And you're saying that essentially helped facilitate this more creative, more kind of genre bending style.
sentences.zh: 你是说这本质上促进了这种更具创造性、更具流派融合风格的发展。

sentences.en: Because there's no gatekeepers.
sentences.zh: 因为没有守门人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If he had come along five years earlier, he'd have to think, well, how do I get heard?
sentences.zh: 如果他早五年出现，他得想，好吧，我怎么才能被听到？

sentences.en: I get heard by signing to a major label and by getting played on radio.
sentences.zh: 我得通过签约大型唱片公司并在电台播放来被听到。

sentences.en: I probably have to make some concessions in order to have those things happen.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这些，我可能不得不做出一些妥协。

sentences.en: Whereas you come along in the mid-2010s, all of the other platforms are in place.
sentences.zh: 而当你出现在2010年代中期时，所有其他平台都已经就位了。

sentences.en: So, it also seems to me that those streaming platforms help you get famous faster and more within your own control.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我看来，那些流媒体平台也帮助你更快地成名，并且更多地掌握在你自己手中。

sentences.en: And it seems like that happened with Bad Bunny.
sentences.zh: 看起来坏痞兔就是这样。

sentences.en: Like, he just kind of exploded overnight, at least the way I remember it.
sentences.zh: 就像他一夜之间就爆红了，至少我是这么记得的。

sentences.en: When did he show up on your radar screens?
sentences.zh: 他是什么时候出现在你们的雷达上的？

sentences.en: What was the song that kind of put him on the map for you?
sentences.zh: 是哪首歌让你们开始关注他的？

sentences.en: So, in the mid-2010s, there's a song called Soy Peor.
sentences.zh: 在2010年代中期，有一首歌叫《Soy Peor》。

sentences.en: We should listen to a little bit of it.
sentences.zh: 我们应该听一点。

sentences.en: Let's play it.
sentences.zh: 放一下吧。

sentences.en: So, this comes out right at the end of 2016.
sentences.zh: 这首歌是在2016年底发行的。

sentences.en: And Bad Bunny instantly becomes a true, what I would say, a true YouTube star.
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔瞬间成为了一位真正的、我会说是真正的YouTube明星。

sentences.en: This was a novel era where, I think as reporters and critics, we really started to realize that the real action was on the internet.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新颖的时代，我认为作为记者和评论家，我们真的开始意识到真正的行动是在互联网上。

sentences.en: The real action was on SoundCloud.
sentences.zh: 真正的行动是在SoundCloud上。

sentences.en: The real action was on YouTube, and someone like Bad Bunny essentially leapfrogged almost everybody who was signed to a major label.
sentences.zh: 真正的行动是在YouTube上，像坏痞兔这样的人本质上超越了几乎所有签约大型唱片公司的人。

sentences.en: This video and what happened in the next couple years really does coincide with what I would describe as a drop in the quality and influence of major label Spanish language music at that time.
sentences.zh: 这支视频以及随后几年发生的事情，确实与我所描述的当时大型唱片公司西班牙语音乐质量和影响力的下降相吻合。

sentences.en: By the end of 2018, he puts out a full-length album, Por Siempre.
sentences.zh: 到2018年底，他发行了一张全长专辑《Por Siempre》。

sentences.en: I remember having to review this, I'm pretty sure, on Christmas in 2018, and it was, I thought, one of the most creative albums that had come out of that space, period.
sentences.zh: 我记得我得在2018年圣诞节那天评论这张专辑，我认为这是那个领域里最有创意的专辑之一，没有之一。

sentences.en: It was mindful of pop and also mindful of history.
sentences.zh: 它既有流行意识，也有历史意识。

sentences.en: The thing about Bad Bunny that I find so fascinating is we all sit here and talk about him as a progressive.
sentences.zh: 关于坏痞兔，我发现最迷人的一点是，我们都坐在这里把他当作一个进步派来谈论。

sentences.en: We talk about him as an innovator and as someone who's breaking rules.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论他是一位创新者，是一位打破规则的人。

sentences.en: How do you break rules?
sentences.zh: 你怎么打破规则？

sentences.en: You have to understand the rules to break the rules.
sentences.zh: 你必须了解规则才能打破规则。

sentences.en: And I would venture to say that Bad Bunny knows more about reggaeton history than most people currently making the music, even if he's constantly sort of like violating its tenets.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，坏痞兔比大多数目前在做这种音乐的人更了解雷鬼动的历史，即使他一直在某种程度上违反其准则。

sentences.en: The other thing I wanted to say about Bad Bunny's musical rise is that he's also coming post-American rap, being completely changed by people like Kanye West and Drake.
sentences.zh: 关于坏痞兔的音乐崛起，我还想说的是，他也是在后美国饶舌时代出现的，这个时代已经被坎耶·韦斯特和德雷克这样的人彻底改变了。

sentences.en: Tell me how.
sentences.zh: 告诉我怎么改变的。

sentences.en: So, Bad Bunny is mixing, singing, and rapping.
sentences.zh: 所以，坏痞兔在混合演唱和饶舌。

sentences.en: He's bringing an extremely melodic touch to reggaeton, which is traditionally a more serrated, in-your-face, rapid-fire rapping genre.
sentences.zh: 他为雷鬼动带来了一种极其旋律化的触感，而雷鬼动传统上是一种更刺耳、更直接、更快速的饶舌流派。

sentences.en: And he's softening its edges.
sentences.zh: 他正在软化它的棱角。

sentences.en: John mentions, por siempre, the Bad Bunny debut album.
sentences.zh: 约翰提到了坏痞兔的首张专辑《Por Siempre》。

sentences.en: The real moment when I stood up and took notice of Bad Bunny was the debut single from that album, which is called Estamos Bien.
sentences.zh: 我真正站起来注意到坏痞兔的时刻是那张专辑的主打单曲，叫《Estamos Bien》。

sentences.en: And it has this extremely dreamy music video.
sentences.zh: 它有一个极其梦幻的音乐视频。

sentences.en: Again, you see the painted nails.
sentences.zh: 同样，你看到了涂了指甲油的手。

sentences.en: You see a guy who doesn't look, even in the video for Soy Peor, he looks like pretty much a standard reggaeton artiSt.
sentences.zh: 你看到一个看起来不像的人，即使在《Soy Peor》的视频里，他看起来也像个标准的雷鬼动艺人。

sentences.en: He looks like a rapper.
sentences.zh: 他看起来像个饶舌歌手。

sentences.en: He's taking from all of these different strains of basically post-iPod music, right?
sentences.zh: 他正在从所有这些基本上属于后iPod时代的音乐流派中汲取灵感，对吧？

sentences.en: When we think about young people growing up listening to everything, not just the one CD they can afford on a given week.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到年轻人成长过程中听着一切，而不仅仅是他们每周能买得起的那一张CD时。

sentences.en: But if you grow up in the time of iTunes and YouTube and file sharing.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是在iTunes、YouTube和文件共享的时代长大的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

sentences.zh: 突然之间，整个世界都尽在你的掌握之中。

sentences.en: Exactly, and Bad Bunny was very much a vessel for all of these things combining at once.
sentences.zh: 没错，Bad Bunny 确实成为了所有这些因素同时汇聚的载体。

sentences.en: And he's doing it in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 而且他用的是西班牙语。

sentences.en: You're saying basically that part of the reason he doesn't follow this standard arc, part of the reason he is such a crossover artist, is the time in which he comes up.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，他之所以不走寻常路，之所以能成为如此跨界的艺人，部分原因在于他所处的时代。

sentences.en: It's very specific.
sentences.zh: 这非常特殊。

sentences.zh: 但我们漏掉了一个环节，那就是《Despacito》。

sentences.zh: 什么是《Despacito》环节？

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 是这样，

sentences.zh: 我认为如果不谈 2017 年 Luis Fonsi 和 Daddy Yankee 的那首《Despacito》，就无法讨论 Bad Bunny 和拉丁音乐的流行，以及它下周登上超级碗舞台的意义。

sentences.zh: 那首歌成为了有史以来最伟大的单曲之一，无论语言如何。

sentences.en: This is a Latin pop song from two veteran artists who were not exactly the hottest or coolest at that moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一首拉丁流行歌曲，出自两位资深艺人之手，他们当时并非最火或最酷的歌手。

sentences.en: They made a totally undeniable dance hit that appealed to two-year-olds and 82-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 他们创作了一首完全无法抗拒的舞曲，吸引了从两岁小孩到 82 岁老人的所有听众。

sentences.en: And then they got Justin Bieber on the remix, in which he sings mostly in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 后来他们找来 Justin Bieber 制作了混音版，他在歌中大部分时间都在唱西班牙语。

So this is kind of pre-Bad Bunny's explosion.

sentences.en: It's all happening at the same time, when they realized that because of the way music can traffic online and then bubble up to radio stations, award shows, television performances,
sentences.zh: 这一切都在同时发生，当他们意识到音乐可以通过网络传播，然后逐渐渗透到广播电台、颁奖典礼、电视表演中时，

sentences.en: all of that, they realized there was no going back, right?
sentences.zh: 这一切让他们意识到已经没有回头路了，对吧？

sentences.en: This was a toothpaste out of the tube moment for Latin music or pop music in any language besides English,
sentences.zh: 对于拉丁音乐或任何非英语流行音乐来说，这就像是“覆水难收”的时刻，

sentences.en: in which it became clear that there was a big enough audience to sustain it.
sentences.zh: 很明显，已经有足够庞大的受众来支撑它了。

sentences.en: And I think after Despacito becomes among the longest running chart toppers ever,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在《Despacito》成为史上蝉联榜首时间最长的歌曲之一后，

sentences.en: all of a sudden there's tons of interest and investment in these artists that are allowed to stay who they are.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，人们对这些能够保持自我的艺人产生了浓厚的兴趣和投资意愿。

sentences.en: And also, we talked a little bit earlier about the power of streaming.
sentences.zh: 另外，我们之前也谈到过流媒体的力量。

sentences.en: It's had one of the most visible impacts on Spanish language music because what it did is it sort of aggregated everybody all across the planet,
sentences.zh: 它对西班牙语音乐产生了最直观的影响，因为它将全球各地的人们聚集在了一起，

sentences.en: hundreds of millions of people who speak Spanish, all one home to be able to find music that speaks to them in their language.
sentences.zh: 数以亿计的西班牙语使用者，都在同一个地方寻找能用他们的语言与他们产生共鸣的音乐。

sentences.en: It also makes it so the artists don't have to compromise to reach that level of audience.
sentences.zh: 这也使得艺人们不必为了达到那种受众规模而做出妥协。

sentences.en: If there's a middleman, if there's a gatekeeper in between a visionary artist and hundreds of millions of people, there's probably some negotiation going on, in this case,
sentences.zh: 如果一位富有远见的艺人和数亿听众之间存在中间人或把关人，通常会涉及一些谈判，在这种情况下，

sentences.en: specifically in terms of language.
sentences.zh: 特别是在语言方面。

sentences.zh: Bad Bunny 他——

sentences.zh: 很好，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.zh: 没错，Bad Bunny 在他登上超级碗舞台的过程中，从未用英语演唱或说唱过。

sentences.en: And just to put a fine point on that, that's something that his predecessors in the world of Latin music did, right?
sentences.zh: 为了强调这一点，这确实是他那些拉丁音乐界的前辈们曾经做过的事，对吧？

sentences.zh: 我是说，想想 Marc Anthony 和 Shakira。

sentences.en: There were English versions of their songs.
sentences.zh: 他们的歌曲都有英文版本。

sentences.en: I mean, they did Spanish music, but they also made music that wasn't English, theoretically, to appeal directly to this audience.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们虽然做西班牙语音乐，但理论上他们也会制作非英语音乐，以直接吸引这些受众。

sentences.en: So why did Bad Bunny not do that?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么 Bad Bunny 不这样做呢？

sentences.en: And, I mean, you guys talked to him.
sentences.zh: 而且，你们采访过他。

sentences.en: What's his relationship to that decision?
sentences.zh: 他对于这个决定是怎么看的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, he represents a new kind of pop star for the 21st century in which the musicians can commune directly with their audiences.
sentences.zh: 是的，他代表了 21 世纪的一种新型流行歌星，音乐人可以直接与他们的受众交流。

sentences.en: You think of artists like BTS.
sentences.zh: 想想像 BTS 这样的艺人。

sentences.en: This is the K-pop group.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个韩国流行组合。

sentences.en: Again, on the level of Bad Bunny, billions and billions and billions of plays, entire economies built around them.
sentences.zh: 同样，在 Bad Bunny 的层面上，拥有数十亿次的播放量，围绕他们建立了整个经济体系。

sentences.en: And they sing in Korean.
sentences.zh: 而且他们用韩语演唱。

sentences.en: And they reach listeners all around the world, some of whom speak Korean, some of whom learn Korean because of this music,
sentences.zh: 他们触及了世界各地的听众，有些人会说韩语，有些人因为这些音乐而学习韩语，

sentences.en: and some of whom have no idea what's being sung or rapped.
sentences.zh: 还有些人根本不知道歌词或说唱内容是什么。

sentences.en: And I think all of that goes for Bad Bunny as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切也同样适用于 Bad Bunny。

sentences.en: And, I mean, you guys talked to him about this on podcasts, on your show.
sentences.zh: 而且，你们在播客和节目中和他谈过这个问题。

sentences.en: What does he say about it?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Because it's a decision, right?
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个决定，对吧？

sentences.en: It's a decision to do it in the beginning and to stick with it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个从一开始就做出的决定，并且一直坚持了下来。

sentences.en: I mean, it's now been years and years of this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这都已经过去好多年了。

sentences.en: I hope you'll play the part from our interview where I think, Joe, you asked him, right?
sentences.zh: 我希望你能播放我们采访中的那一段，我想 Joe，是你问他的，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Good idea.
sentences.zh: 好主意。

sentences.en: Let's play it.
sentences.zh: 我们来听听。

sentences.en: Now that your music is reaching so many millions of people around the world,
sentences.zh: 现在你的音乐正触及全球数以百万计的听众，

sentences.en: is there a part of you that feels like listeners who don't understand the lyrics are missing something and will never fully grasp what you're trying to convey?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得那些听不懂歌词的听众错过了什么，永远无法完全领会你想要传达的东西？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Definitely people miss a lot of, a lot of...
sentences.zh: 人们确实错过了很多，很多……

sentences.en: Nuance.
sentences.zh: 细微差别。

sentences.en: Yeah, actually, even there's a lot of Latinos who speak Spanish that they're missing a lot, I think, because I'm singing in Puerto Rican slang.
sentences.zh: 是的，其实即使是很多说西班牙语的拉丁裔，我认为他们也错过了很多，因为我用的是波多黎各俚语。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 我问他这是否困扰他，他是否希望听众能更努力一点，或者他自己能更努力地去与他们沟通，去迁就他们。

sentences.en: And what'd he say?
sentences.zh: 他怎么说？

sentences.en: He said, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不在乎。

sentences.en: And he leaned into it.
sentences.zh: 而且他坚持了自己的立场。

sentences.en: He said it very melodically.

sentences.en: It's a melodic.
sentences.zh: 很有旋律。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: It's almost like the proliferation of streaming.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像流媒体的普及一样。

sentences.en: What it does is kind of show that the hegemony of the English language was a fallacy the whole time.
sentences.zh: 它所做的就是证明了英语的霸权地位一直以来都是一种谬论。

sentences.en: Always was.
sentences.zh: 一直都是。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Always was.
sentences.zh: 一直都是。

sentences.en: And Bad Bunny walks through that door and kind of opens this new world where it becomes very clear that many, many people, you know, not just Spanish speakers, want to hear this.
sentences.zh: Bad Bunny 走进了那扇门，开启了一个新世界，很明显，许多许多人，不仅仅是西班牙语使用者，都想听这些音乐。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then he goes on this insane run, right?
sentences.zh: 然后他开启了一段疯狂的旅程，对吧？

sentences.zh: 他发行了六张专辑，还不算混音带和合作作品，六张他个人的独唱专辑。

sentences.en: Un Verano Sentí comes out in 2022.
sentences.zh: 《Un Verano Sin Ti》于 2022 年发行。

sentences.en: That's sort of the high watermark up to that point.
sentences.zh: 那是他当时的一个巅峰之作。

sentences.en: That's, I think, widely considered his masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 我认为那被广泛认为是他的杰作。

sentences.en: And that's because it combines everything that he's good at.
sentences.zh: 那是因为它结合了他所有擅长的东西。

sentences.en: It combines the sort of Lovelorn singing he does, the Latin trap rapping, the sort of tossed-off fun stuff, but also stadium-filling antheMs.
sentences.zh: 它结合了他那种失恋情歌、拉丁陷阱说唱、那种随性有趣的风格，还有能填满体育场的赞歌。

sentences.en: And then you get to 2025.
sentences.zh: 然后到了 2025 年。

sentences.en: January 5th, 2025, he puts out Debi Tirar Mas Fotos, his most recent album.
sentences.zh: 2025 年 1 月 5 日，他发行了《Debi Tirar Más Fotos》，这是他最近的一张专辑。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is a bit of a swerve for him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这算是一个转折。

sentences.en: And the album starts with a song called Nueva York.
sentences.zh: 专辑以一首名为《Nueva York》的歌开始。

sentences.en: Nueva York!
sentences.zh: 纽约！

sentences.en: About Latin Americans in New York.
sentences.zh: 关于在纽约的拉丁裔。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how he can feel at home here.
sentences.zh: 以及他在这里如何感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: And it's traditional instrumentation.
sentences.zh: 而且它采用了传统的配器。

sentences.en: It's not as digital as everything he's done in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 不像他过去做的所有东西那样数字化。

sentences.en: It has this sort of bespoke homemade feel to it.
sentences.zh: 它有一种定制的、手工制作的感觉。

sentences.en: It's party music, but it's nodding to all of the various styles that come together to make this moment of Latin music explosion, both personally and, I think, internationally.
sentences.zh: 这是派对音乐，但它向所有促成这一拉丁音乐爆发时刻的各种风格致敬，无论是在个人层面，还是我认为在国际层面。

sentences.en: This is an album of memory.
sentences.zh: 这是一张关于记忆的专辑。

sentences.en: It's called I Should Have Taken More Photos.
sentences.zh: 它的名字叫《我本该多拍些照片》。

sentences.en: It's a breakup album, but it's also an album about being away from Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 这是一张分手专辑，但也是一张关于远离波多黎各的专辑。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny had spent a year living in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: Bad Bunny 在洛杉矶生活了一年。

sentences.en: Being very famous.
sentences.zh: 变得非常出名。

sentences.en: Being very famous.
sentences.zh: 变得非常出名。

sentences.en: Being paparazzi'd with Kendall Jenner, his alleged girlfriend at the time.
sentences.zh: 被狗仔队拍到和当时的绯闻女友 Kendall Jenner 在一起。

sentences.en: And becoming this huge star who lives either on the road or in the Hollywood Hills.
sentences.zh: 成为了一个要么在巡演路上，要么住在好莱坞山上的超级巨星。

sentences.en: And then this album represents, I think, him coming back home and once again, as he'd done throughout his career to this point, but now with a brighter spotlight,
sentences.zh: 我认为这张专辑代表了他回到家乡，再一次像他职业生涯至今所做的那样，但现在是在更耀眼的聚光灯下，

sentences.en: showing people where he comes from.
sentences.zh: 向人们展示他的出身。

sentences.en: It's interesting because you guys have sketched a trajectory of this megastar where it seems as though as he became more famous, as his profile and his influence grew, you know,
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为你们勾勒出了这位巨星的轨迹，似乎随着他变得更出名，随着他的知名度和影响力增长，你知道，

sentences.en: he's a total star.
sentences.zh: 他是一个彻头彻尾的明星。

sentences.en: And at the same time, it sounds like he's deepening his commitment to traditional music.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，听起来他正在加深对传统音乐的投入。

sentences.en: It's an interesting dovetailing of personal narrative, musical narrative, and I think political narrative, even if it's a tiny bit supplemented.
sentences.zh: 这是个人叙事、音乐叙事和政治叙事之间有趣的交织，即使只是一点点补充。

sentences.en: But it is there.
sentences.zh: 但它确实存在。

sentences.en: So to me, you get to a certain level of fame and invariably you're making some kind of sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，当你达到一定程度的声望时，你总是会做出某种牺牲。

sentences.en: You're sacrificing your privacy, you're sacrificing your ability to make decisions on your own without consultation with others,
sentences.zh: 你牺牲了隐私，牺牲了在没有与他人商量的情况下独自做决定的能力，

sentences.en: without thinking about how it might affect future opportunities.
sentences.zh: 牺牲了不去考虑它可能会如何影响未来机会的能力。

sentences.en: You're running essentially a small business.
sentences.zh: 你本质上是在经营一家小企业。

sentences.en: Not that small.
sentences.zh: 也不算太小。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: In this case.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下。

sentences.en: You are, as Joe said earlier, you are your own economy in a way.
sentences.zh: 正如 Joe 之前所说，你在某种程度上就是你自己的经济体。

sentences.zh: 我认为看到一个真正处于巅峰状态的人，本可以完全说，你知道我在做什么吗？

sentences.zh: 但他却说，不，我对我有道德义务。

sentences.zh: 我对波多黎各音乐界的前辈们有创作义务。

sentences.zh: 我有情感义务去创作一些忠于我精神的东西。

sentences.zh: 我认为这很大程度上是因为当他越来越远离家乡时，那里发生的事情。

sentences.zh: 波多黎各，过去十年经常出现在新闻中。

sentences.zh: 2017 年，就在 Bad Bunny 成为超级巨星的时候，玛丽亚飓风袭击了那里。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 岛上有许多人丧生，你知道，

sentences.zh: 导致了多年来因政府对该危机的处理以及美国对该危机的处理而引发的政治动荡。

sentences.zh: 我认为 Bad Bunny 在公众面前实时经历了政治觉醒。

sentences.zh: 2019 年发生了一件事，很好地说明了这一点，

sentences.zh: 是的，冷酷无情。

sentences.en: Callousness and disrespect for the dead from Hurricane Maria.
sentences.zh: 对玛丽亚飓风遇难者的冷酷无情和不尊重。

sentences.en: And Puerto Ricans take to the streets.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各人走上了街头。

sentences.en: And Bad Bunny is on this big European tour at the time.
sentences.zh: 而 Bad Bunny 当时正在进行大型欧洲巡演。

sentences.en: And what does he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: He cancels his shows.
sentences.zh: 他取消了演出。

sentences.en: He flies home.
sentences.zh: 他飞回了家。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He records a protest anthem with two other Puerto Rican artists, Residente and Ile.
sentences.zh: 他与其他两位波多黎各艺人 Residente 和 Ile 录制了一首抗议歌曲。

sentences.en: And they put out this song, which translates to sharpening the knives.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了这首歌，翻译过来就是“磨快刀子”。

sentences.en: And Bad Bunny calls out the governor by name.
sentences.zh: Bad Bunny 点名批评了州长。

sentences.en: And takes to the streets.
sentences.zh: 并走上了街头。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny says, my people need me.
sentences.zh: Bad Bunny 说，我的人民需要我。

sentences.en: I'm going to be beside them.
sentences.zh: 我会站在他们那边。

sentences.en: And in part because of these protests, the governor ends up resigning.
sentences.zh: 部分是因为这些抗议活动，州长最终辞职了。

sentences.en: I think that's Bad Bunny coming into his power.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是坏痞兔（Bad Bunny）开始展现他的影响力了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And from there, he doesn't stop any time he feels the call to say something, in particular something about Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，只要他觉得有必要发声，尤其是关于波多黎各的事情，他就从未停止过。

sentences.en: He's becoming, you're saying, a kind of explicitly political figure in this moment.
sentences.zh: 你是说，他此刻正在成为一个明确的政治人物。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I think he's doing something very careful.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我认为他做得非常谨慎。

sentences.en: And I think something that other artists, frankly, could take note of, which is he's speaking about issues that are meaningful to him personally.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我认为其他艺人可以借鉴他的一点是：他所谈论的都是对他个人有意义的问题。

sentences.en: And I think that comes across any time he decides he's going to stand up and say something.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，每当他决定站出来说些什么时，这种真诚感就会传达出来。

sentences.en: It's because it's an issue that is near and dear to him and where he comes from.
sentences.zh: 因为那是他切身相关、且源于他成长背景的问题。

sentences.en: It seems authentic.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很真实。

sentences.en: It doesn't seem like he's trying on some sort of political shirt that day.
sentences.zh: 看起来并不像是他那天随手披上了一件政治外衣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then there's this, there's this other political moment that I honestly learned about preparing for this show with you guys, which is this song Yo Pereo Sola.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个政治时刻，老实说，我是为了准备这期节目才从你们那儿了解到的，那就是这首歌《Yo Perreo Sola》。

sentences.en: Yo Pereo Sola.
sentences.zh: 我独自跳舞。

sentences.en: I mean, it's I Twerk Alone in English, and it's about a woman who dances alone.
sentences.zh: 意思是“我独自电臀舞”，讲的是一个独自跳舞的女性。

sentences.en: It's a song essentially about sexual harassment and violence against women.
sentences.zh: 这首歌本质上是关于性骚扰和针对女性的暴力。

sentences.en: And I did not know that because I experienced that song as an amazing song to dance to and have, like, a great time listening to.
sentences.zh: 我之前并不知道这一点，因为我一直把它当作一首很棒的舞曲来听，听的时候感觉很开心。

sentences.en: I learned it was political, which makes sense.
sentences.zh: 后来我才知道它具有政治含义，这也很合理。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I wonder what to make of that.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我不知道该怎么看待这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the genius of Bad Bunny and I think any great pop figure who is interested in Trojan horsing more complicated ideas in digestible, joyful, celebratory packages.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是坏痞兔的天才之处，我认为任何伟大的流行人物，如果对用易于消化、快乐、欢庆的方式来包装更复杂的“特洛伊木马”思想感兴趣，都会这么做。

sentences.en: One of the things that Bad Bunny has done really effectively in a way that I think prevents people from feeling like he's preachy is pairing these things in a way that feels natural,
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔做得非常有效的一点是——我认为这能防止人们觉得他在说教——他将这些议题以一种自然的方式结合起来，

sentences.en: but also in a way that you can just enjoy on their surface level.
sentences.zh: 同时也让你能在表面上单纯地享受音乐。

sentences.en: Okay, which I think brings us just about to near the present moment.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想这差不多把我们带到了当下。

sentences.en: You said he comes out with this album, his most recent album, in January 2025, obviously the same month that Donald Trump is inaugurated as president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 你说他在2025年1月发行了这张专辑，也就是他最近的一张专辑，显然这正是唐纳德·特朗普就任美国总统的同一个月。

sentences.en: He then makes a series of decisions around that album and the performances of those songs in the United States that are making more direct statements politically in the United States.
sentences.zh: 随后，他围绕这张专辑以及在美国的演出做出了一系列决定，这些决定在美国政治上发出了更直接的声明。

sentences.en: Walk me through those, John.
sentences.zh: 约翰，带我了解一下这些情况吧。

sentences.en: So we talked about this album as a homecoming for him, and he makes that explicit by saying, yes, I'm going to perform.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到这张专辑是他的一次回归，他明确表示：是的，我会演出。

sentences.en: But I'm not going to perform in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但我不会在美国演出。

sentences.en: I'm not going to perform in California or New York or Texas.
sentences.zh: 我不会在加州、纽约或德州演出。

sentences.en: I'm going to perform dozens of shows in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 我要在波多黎各举办几十场演出。

sentences.en: And if you want to come see me, you have to come see me.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看我演出，你就得亲自过来。

sentences.en: Make a trip of it.
sentences.zh: 把它当作一次旅行。

sentences.en: Come.
sentences.zh: 过来吧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Come put your money where my mouth is.
sentences.zh: 来吧，用行动支持我的主张。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Wow, that's really good.
sentences.zh: 哇，这真的很棒。

sentences.en: That's good.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

sentences.en: Later,
sentences.zh: 后来，

sentences.en: he says part of that decision is attributable to concerns about how his concerts and the fans that might be gathered at his concerts might be used as cudgels in the ongoing immigration enforcement actions of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他说做出这个决定的一部分原因是担心他的演唱会以及聚集在演唱会的粉丝，可能会被特朗普政府在持续进行的移民执法行动中当作攻击的把柄。

sentences.en: And saying explicitly, I don't want to give ICE and Trump an obvious target to come and gather folks up.
sentences.zh: 他明确表示：我不想给美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）和特朗普一个显眼的目标，让他们去抓人。

sentences.en: This performance at the Super Bowl, it will be Bad Bunny's first performance in the continental U.S.
sentences.zh: 这次超级碗的表演，将是坏痞兔自做出那个决定以来，首次在美国本土的演出。

sentences.en: since he made that decision to not show up here for fear of ICE and for these reasons.
sentences.zh: 因为担心ICE和这些原因，他一直没来这里演出。

sentences.en: First public performance, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，首次公开演出。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: First one in front of a crowd.
sentences.zh: 第一次面对观众的演出。

sentences.en: And it's not just any crowd and it's not just any performance, but it's this television moment with all of these political stakes swirling around it.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是普通的观众，也不是普通的演出，而是一个围绕着各种政治利害关系的电视时刻。

sentences.en: And no one knows how he's going to use that timing.
sentences.zh: 没人知道他会如何利用这个时机。

sentences.en: Let's take a quick break.
sentences.zh: 我们先休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we come back, we're going to look at why the NFL decided to offer this stage to Bad Bunny and all the complications around that.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将探讨为什么NFL决定给坏痞兔提供这个舞台，以及围绕此事的种种复杂情况。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露（Winnalou）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试着捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So when the news came out in September that Bad Bunny was the pick for the Super Bowl halftime show, I have to say I was honestly surprised because I couldn't believe the NFL,
sentences.zh: 所以当9月份有消息称坏痞兔被选为超级碗中场秀的表演嘉宾时，我必须说我真的很惊讶，因为我无法相信NFL，

sentences.en: which is not a league known for pushing boundaries, chose someone who was going to be this politically contentious.
sentences.zh: 一个并不以突破界限著称的联盟，竟然选择了这样一个具有政治争议性的人。

sentences.en: So explain that to me.
sentences.zh: 所以，给我解释一下。

sentences.en: This all goes back to what happened with the NFL and Colin Kaepernick.
sentences.zh: 这一切都要追溯到NFL和科林·卡佩尼克（Colin Kaepernick）之间发生的事情。

sentences.en: He is expected to kneel once again and protest to what he says are social injustices to African-Americans.
sentences.zh: 预计他将再次下跪，抗议他所说的针对非裔美国人的社会不公。

sentences.en: Around 2016,
sentences.zh: 大约在2016年，

sentences.en: you have this quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers who takes it upon himself to kneel during the national anthem before football games in protest of the police treatment of black men.
sentences.zh: 这位旧金山49人队的四分卫，在橄榄球赛前的国歌环节中选择下跪，以抗议警察对待黑人的方式。

sentences.en: And believe me, if Colin Kaepernick were on this program, The Factor right now,
sentences.zh: 相信我，如果科林·卡佩尼克现在在这个节目《The Factor》上，

sentences.en: he'd be sacked within seconds because his knowledge of current events is sadly lacking based upon what he has said so far.
sentences.zh: 他几秒钟内就会被解雇，因为根据他目前所说的，他对时事的了解实在令人遗憾。

sentences.en: He was essentially pushed out and blacklisted from the NFL and the NFL had a really hard time responding to the social upheaval that came from this.
sentences.zh: 他基本上被踢出了NFL并被列入黑名单，而NFL对于由此引发的社会动荡感到非常难以应对。

sentences.en: And that was reflected in part by its inability to book black and relevant acts for its halftime show.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上反映在它无法为中场秀预订黑人且具有影响力的艺人上。

sentences.en: And you're saying part of the problem for the NFL at this point is that it has a tough time dealing with this moment and that alienates artists who wants to book for the halftime show.
sentences.zh: 你是说NFL此时面临的部分问题是，它很难处理这一时刻，而这疏远了那些想在中场秀表演的艺人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this all comes to a head in 2019 when the Super Bowl was in Atlanta, the capital of black music in modern times.
sentences.zh: 这一切在2019年达到了顶峰，当时超级碗在亚特兰大举行，那是现代黑人音乐之都。

sentences.en: And everyone is thinking, oh, all the amazing rappers or R&B singers that they could book for the Atlanta Super Bowl halftime show.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在想，哦，他们可以为亚特兰大超级碗中场秀预订所有那些了不起的说唱歌手或R&B歌手。

sentences.en: So there's reports that Rihanna turned the show down, Rihanna sort of at the peak of her world-beating success at that moment.
sentences.zh: 有报道称蕾哈娜（Rihanna）拒绝了演出，当时她正处于事业巅峰。

sentences.en: And she says, allegedly, according to reporting, I don't want any part of this post-Kaepernick.
sentences.zh: 据报道，她说：在卡佩尼克事件之后，我不想参与其中。

sentences.en: As a protest, you're saying, of the NFL's treatment of Kaepernick.
sentences.zh: 你是说这是对NFL对待卡佩尼克方式的一种抗议。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Instead, we get Maroon 5.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们得到了魔力红（Maroon 5）。

sentences.en: You really, at that moment, could not pick a more anodyne artist to headline the Super Bowl halftime show,
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，你真的找不到比他们更平庸的艺人来领衔超级碗中场秀了，

sentences.en: which we want to underscore is the biggest concert on American soil every year.
sentences.zh: 我们要强调的是，这可是每年美国本土最大的演唱会。

sentences.en: No offense to Maroon 5.
sentences.zh: 对魔力红没有冒犯的意思。

sentences.en: Yes, offense to Maroon 5.
sentences.zh: 不，就是冒犯魔力红。

sentences.en: What are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 你在说什么？

sentences.en: Is there a stand name for Maroon 5?
sentences.zh: 魔力红有粉丝团名称吗？

sentences.en: The Maroon 5 Mafia?
sentences.zh: “魔力红黑手党”？

sentences.en: The Maroon 5 Mafia.
sentences.zh: “魔力红黑手党”。

sentences.en: Yes, all offense to Maroon 5, who, I think I said something in my piece, who said, would have lost all credibility had they any credibility to lose.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是要冒犯魔力红，我想我在文章里说过，如果他们还有什么信誉可言的话，那次演出让他们彻底丧失了信誉。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Maybe the positive outcome of that is it makes everyone realize, uh-oh, this has to be fixed.
sentences.zh: 也许积极的结果是，这让每个人都意识到，噢，这必须得解决。

sentences.en: And so the NFL realizes they have a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以NFL意识到他们出了问题。

sentences.en: By the way, I'm getting a note that the Maroon 5 fans are called the Marooners, just in case anybody wants to.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我收到一条消息，魔力红的粉丝被称为“Marooners”，以防有人想知道。

sentences.en: Because they're stuck on an island and no one wants to rescue them?
sentences.zh: 因为他们被困在岛上，没人想去救他们？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, they're catching strays.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们真是躺着也中枪。

sentences.en: They set themselves up for that one.
sentences.zh: 他们自己找的。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Okay, so the NFL is at its low point with this Maroon 5 performance.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以NFL在魔力红那场演出时跌入了低谷。

sentences.en: Get me up to speed.
sentences.zh: 让我了解一下最新情况。

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Because obviously there's some recovery.
sentences.zh: 因为显然他们有所恢复。

sentences.en: They need help.
sentences.zh: 他们需要帮助。

sentences.en: They call Jay-Z.
sentences.zh: 他们找了Jay-Z。

sentences.en: Jay-Z's Roc Nation, his entertainment company, has a sports wing.
sentences.zh: Jay-Z的Roc Nation娱乐公司有一个体育部门。

sentences.en: Jay-Z has a history of, let's say, bridging the gap between street-level culture and boardrooMs.
sentences.zh: Jay-Z在弥合街头文化与董事会之间的鸿沟方面有着悠久的历史。

sentences.en: That's his whole MO, especially in the latter half of his career.
sentences.zh: 这是他职业生涯后半段的主要行事方式。

sentences.en: And the NFL brings on Roc Nation as a partner to help them in the selection of Super Bowl halftime performers
sentences.zh: NFL引入Roc Nation作为合作伙伴，帮助他们挑选超级碗中场秀的表演者，

sentences.en: and all other entertainment that goes around the edges of that throughout the NFL season.
sentences.zh: 以及整个NFL赛季期间所有相关的娱乐活动。

sentences.en: They're in repair mode.
sentences.zh: 他们处于修复模式。

sentences.en: They're in repair mode and they need a...
sentences.zh: 他们处于修复模式，需要一个……

sentences.en: It's a plausible cover.
sentences.zh: 这是一个合理的掩护。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they need a diplomat.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一个外交官。

sentences.en: Jay-Z immediately faces a ton of backlash for this.
sentences.zh: Jay-Z立刻因此面临了巨大的反弹。

sentences.en: He had previously been a supporter of Colin Kaepernick's.
sentences.zh: 他之前曾是科林·卡佩尼克的支持者。

sentences.en: And people say he's sold out.
sentences.zh: 人们说他出卖了原则。

sentences.en: People say he's collaborating with the enemy, etc.
sentences.zh: 人们说他与敌人勾结，等等。

sentences.en: The way Jay-Z frames it as, I'm here to make change from the inside.
sentences.zh: Jay-Z的说法是：我在这里是为了从内部做出改变。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So Roc Nation then works to book a string of slightly more relevant, slightly more diverse halftime shows.
sentences.zh: 于是Roc Nation开始着手预订一系列稍微更有影响力、稍微更多元化的中场秀。

sentences.en: So the very first Roc Nation halftime show is Shakira and Jennifer Lopez.
sentences.zh: Roc Nation的第一场中场秀是夏奇拉（Shakira）和詹妮弗·洛佩兹（Jennifer Lopez）。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny actually makes a cameo during that performance.
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔实际上在那场表演中客串了一下。

sentences.en: And then you get The Weeknd, you get Rihanna eventually.
sentences.zh: 然后是威肯（The Weeknd），最后是蕾哈娜。

sentences.en: And then there's this one big moment for the Super Bowl that I think is the Band-Aid, the Jay-Z shaped Band-Aid on top of everything, which is rap gets its shine.
sentences.zh: 超级碗还有一个重要的时刻，我认为那是贴在一切之上的创可贴，一个Jay-Z形状的创可贴，那就是说唱音乐大放异彩。

sentences.en: There's a Super Bowl halftime show starring Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg, Mary J.
sentences.zh: 有一场超级碗中场秀由德瑞博士（Dr. Dre）和史努比狗狗（Snoop Dogg）、玛丽·布莱姬（Mary J. Blige）领衔，

sentences.en: Blige.
sentences.zh: 还有肯德里克·拉马尔（Kendrick Lamar）和阿姆（Eminem）。

sentences.en: Kendrick Lamar and Eminem.
sentences.zh: 在那场演出中还发生了一个非剧本时刻，阿姆为了声援科林·卡佩尼克，在舞台上单膝下跪。

sentences.en: What also happens during that performance is a sort of off-script moment where Eminem, in solidarity with Colin Kaepernick, takes a knee on stage.
sentences.zh: 我认为舞台上的白人艺人觉得他有道德义务去表达这种声援，这并非巧合。

sentences.en: This, I think, not a coincidence that the white artist on stage felt like he had the moral imperative to make the show of solidarity.
sentences.zh: 也许还有余地。

sentences.en: And also maybe the leeway.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，还有资本。

sentences.en: Yeah, and the currency.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是NFL喜欢看到的事情。

sentences.en: But this is something that I don't think the NFL loved.
sentences.zh: 然而，这对每个人来说似乎都奏效了。

sentences.en: And yet, it sort of works for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我想当谈到坏痞兔时，我们也会提到这个想法，那就是：你希望这感觉有一点点危险，尤其是如果Jay-Z参与其中并说，

sentences.en: And I think we'll get to this idea when it comes to Bad Bunny is like, you want this to feel a little bit dangerous, especially if Jay-Z is involved and saying,
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，我们不会向企业资金和所有权屈服。

sentences.en: no, no, no, we're not capitulating to corporate dollars and ownership.
sentences.zh: 我们正在将我们的文化带到世界舞台上。

sentences.en: We are bringing our culture to the world stage.
sentences.zh: 我们正在我们通常不被允许的空间里做我们擅长的事。

sentences.en: We're doing what we do in this space where we typically were not allowed.
sentences.zh: 所以，你希望能够告诉艺人们，他们会拥有一些自由，

sentences.en: So, you want to be able to tell the artists that they're going to have some freedom,
sentences.zh: 他们能够利用那些关注度，向观众展示一些他们可能看不到的东西，如果，你知道，

sentences.en: that they're going to be able to take those eyeballs and show them something that they might not see if, you know,
sentences.zh: 托比·基思（Toby Keith），愿他安息，是超级碗的领衔嘉宾的话。

sentences.en: Toby Keith, may he rest in peace, was headlining the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 你是说，带有一丝反叛色彩对所有人都有帮助。

sentences.en: You're saying, like, a whiff of transgressiveness is helpful to all.
sentences.zh: 没错，这能留住观众。

sentences.en: Right, that keeps people watching.
sentences.zh: 而且，看，Jay-Z加入帮助监督中场秀，是嘻哈音乐中关于“资本主义即行动主义”或这两个领域重叠的长期对话的又一步。

sentences.en: It's also, look, Jay-Z coming on to help supervise the halftime show is another step in this long sort of conversation in hip-hop
sentences.zh: 我认为多年来的主张是，说唱音乐的巨大规模、力量和企业影响力本身就是一种行动主义。

sentences.en: about capitalism as activism or the overlaps of those two spaces.
sentences.zh: 关于将资本主义作为一种行动主义，或者这两者之间的重叠之处。

sentences.en: And I think the proposition for many years was that the sheer scale, power, and corporate influence of rap music was a form of activism in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 我认为多年来的观点是，说唱音乐所具备的巨大规模、力量和企业影响力，其本身就是一种行动主义。

sentences.en: It's interesting, last year, Kendrick Lamar performs at the halftime show, kind of in the post-glow of his Drake beef, which is what people were extremely watching for.
sentences.zh: 很有意思，去年肯德里克·拉马尔（Kendrick Lamar）在中场秀表演时，正处于他与德雷克（Drake）闹翻后的余波中，而那正是人们极度关注的焦点。

sentences.en: And we discussed, Joe, you and I, on The Daily last year, I would just say.
sentences.zh: 乔，我们去年在《每日新闻》（The Daily）节目里讨论过，我只想说。

sentences.en: And the only moment of actual protest during that show is actually a totally unscripted moment where a dancer pulls out a flag in support of, I believe, Gaza and Sudan
sentences.zh: 那场演出中唯一真正的抗议时刻，其实是一个完全没有剧本的插曲：一名舞者掏出了一面旗帜，据我所知，是为了支持加沙和苏丹，

sentences.en: and is summarily whisked off of the field into the bowels of the stadium.
sentences.zh: 随后他被迅速带离球场，送进了体育场的深处。

sentences.en: By security.
sentences.zh: 被安保人员带走的。

sentences.en: By security, because that is not...
sentences.zh: 被安保人员带走的，因为那并不是……

sentences.en: Obviously, you have this moment right when it happens to say, oh, was that intended, but not intended, but intended?
sentences.zh: 显然，当事情发生时，你会立刻想：哦，这是故意的吗？还是无意的？或者是故意安排的？

sentences.en: But actually, no.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，并不是。

sentences.en: And this is a tradition at the Super Bowl, right?
sentences.zh: 而且这在超级碗上是个传统，对吧？

sentences.en: We talk about Janet Jackson and the wardrobe malfunction that I think, you know, people still debate whether or not...
sentences.zh: 我们谈论珍妮·杰克逊（Janet Jackson）那次“走光事故”，我想，人们至今还在争论那是否……

sentences.en: Which we should remind people was the moment at which Justin Timberlake ripped Janet Jackson's...
sentences.zh: 我们应该提醒大家，那一刻是贾斯汀·汀布莱克（Justin Timberlake）扯下了珍妮·杰克逊的……

sentences.en: Costume revealing...
sentences.zh: 服装，露出了……

sentences.en: Her breaSt.
sentences.zh: 她的乳房。

sentences.en: Her breast and some jewelry.
sentences.zh: 她的乳房和一些珠宝。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And people still to this day argue about whether or not that was intended, whether that was part of the show to drive attention,
sentences.zh: 直到今天，人们还在争论那是否是故意的，是否是演出的一部分，为了博取眼球，

sentences.en: but certainly drove countless FCC complaints and became a years, if not decades-long controversy.
sentences.zh: 但它确实引发了无数针对联邦通信委员会（FCC）的投诉，并演变成了一场持续数年甚至数十年的争议。

sentences.en: And we've had these moments since then, you know, whether it's Prince going super phallic with his guitar when he's supposed to be the safe choice.
sentences.zh: 从那以后我们经历过不少这样的时刻，比如王子（Prince）在被视为“安全选择”的情况下，却用吉他做出了极具性暗示的动作。

sentences.en: You have one year Madonna performs, and MIA, the sort of activist rapper, throws a middle finger up, and that becomes a days-long news cycle, right?
sentences.zh: 还有一年麦当娜（Madonna）表演时，激进派说唱歌手MIA竖起了中指，那成了持续数天的新闻热点，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, you need these little moments of off-script, parentheses, question mark, close parentheses,
sentences.zh: 就像是，你需要这些小小的“脱稿”时刻，括号，问号，括号结束，

sentences.en: to keep this thing spicy because you don't want people to use the bathroom or go heat up their nachos.
sentences.zh: 来让节目保持刺激感，因为你不想让观众去上厕所或者去热他们的玉米片。

sentences.en: No, and I get that, but still, the NFL's decision to book Bad Bunny still strikes me as a risky choice for an organization that's trying to theoretically, on the whole,
sentences.zh: 不，我明白你的意思，但NFL决定邀请坏痞兔（Bad Bunny）对我来说，对于一个理论上整体上试图……

sentences.en: avoid a confrontation with the most powerful man in the world.
sentences.zh: 避免与世界上最有权势的人发生冲突的组织来说，仍然是一个冒险的选择。

sentences.en: Trump has been known to target institutions for far less.
sentences.zh: 特朗普可是出了名的会针对那些远没这么严重的机构。

sentences.en: What's more important, potentially, than that?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比这更重要的吗？

sentences.en: And that is ratings.
sentences.zh: 那就是收视率。

sentences.en: You want people to keep watching.
sentences.zh: 你希望人们持续观看。

sentences.en: You want the ad inventory to remain valuable.
sentences.zh: 你希望广告位保持价值。

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 怎么做到呢？

sentences.en: By creating a show that many tens, if not hundreds of millions of people will want to watch.
sentences.zh: 通过制作一场成千上万，甚至上亿人都会想看的演出。

sentences.en: In the modern music era, there's a vanishingly small number of performers in any genre who can achieve that.
sentences.zh: 在现代音乐时代，任何流派中能做到这一点的表演者都屈指可数。

sentences.en: But you have Taylor.
sentences.zh: 但你有泰勒（Taylor）。

sentences.en: Taylor says no, for a variety of reasons, which we can talk about.
sentences.zh: 泰勒拒绝了，原因有很多，我们可以聊聊。

sentences.en: Is that an established fact, that Taylor said no?
sentences.zh: 泰勒拒绝了，这是一个既定事实吗？

sentences.en: So, what Taylor Swift has said is that Jay-Z and Roc Nation made a soft approach to her.
sentences.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）说的是，Jay-Z和Roc Nation曾向她进行过初步接触。

sentences.en: They asked if she might potentially be interested.
sentences.zh: 他们问她是否有兴趣。

sentences.en: But Taylor Swift told Jimmy Fallon that she was not given a hard offer and then sort of did a little dance indicating that she wanted to leave the football to her fiancé,
sentences.zh: 但泰勒·斯威夫特告诉吉米·法伦（Jimmy Fallon），她并没有收到正式邀请，然后她还打了个圆场，暗示她想把橄榄球留给她的未婚夫，

sentences.en: Travis Kelsey, of the Chiefs, and not bring her business into his business.
sentences.zh: 酋长队的特拉维斯·凯尔西（Travis Kelce），不想把她的事业带进他的事业里。

sentences.en: He's not at the Super Bowl, we should note, obviously, spending more time with his family.
sentences.zh: 我们应该指出，他并没有出现在超级碗现场，显然是在花更多时间陪伴家人。

sentences.en: I do want to complicate this idea, though, that Bad Bunny is such a crazy choice for the Super Bowl because, looked at another way, he's the only choice for the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实想反驳那种认为坏痞兔是超级碗“疯狂选择”的观点，因为换个角度看，他是超级碗唯一的选择。

sentences.en: He's basically the guy who had the biggest year.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是这一年里最火的人。

sentences.en: Look at the Grammy nominations.
sentences.zh: 看看格莱美提名就知道了。

sentences.en: He's the star of the Grammy Awards the week before the Super Bowl in the same way that Kendrick was the star of the Grammy Awards the week before the Super Bowl last year.
sentences.zh: 他就像去年超级碗前一周的肯德里克一样，是超级碗前一周格莱美奖的焦点人物。

sentences.en: He is the most relevant man in music.
sentences.zh: 他是当今音乐界最具影响力的人。

sentences.en: So, why wouldn't you put him on the stage that is all about maintaining and amplifying relevance?
sentences.zh: 所以，为什么不让他登上那个旨在维持和扩大影响力的舞台呢？

sentences.en: Okay, let's take another short break, and when we come back, I want to talk about how you think Bad Bunny might meet this moment.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们再休息一下，回来后，我想聊聊你认为坏痞兔会如何应对这一时刻。

sentences.en: What he might do when he actually takes the stage.
sentences.zh: 当他真正登上舞台时会做些什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Okay, one week from today, Bad Bunny will headline the Super Bowl halftime show.
sentences.zh: 好了，距离今天一周后，坏痞兔将领衔超级碗中场秀。

sentences.en: The scene is set for what appears to be an inevitable confrontation of some kind.
sentences.zh: 舞台已经搭好，一场不可避免的冲突似乎即将上演。

sentences.en: Cultural, literal, what do we think?
sentences.zh: 文化的，现实的，我们怎么看？

sentences.en: I think the big question is, what will Bad Bunny be allowed to get away with, and how might he flout those rules and agreements?
sentences.zh: 我认为最大的问题是，坏痞兔会被允许做到什么程度，以及他会如何无视那些规则和协议？

sentences.en: Going into this show, every moment, every second, every micro-movement is carefully choreographed.
sentences.zh: 在进入这场演出时，每一刻、每一秒、每一个微小的动作都是精心编排的。

sentences.en: It is, I assume, signed off on at many, many, many levels of corporate hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 我想，这在企业层级的许多许多层面都经过了审批。

sentences.en: It is quibbled over, negotiated, and eventually agreed upon.
sentences.zh: 经过了反复推敲、协商，最终达成一致。

sentences.en: Everyone's going to hit their marks, but what's left outside of that?
sentences.zh: 每个人都会各就各位，但除此之外还剩下什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, so, okay, it actually would be helpful for me if you guys could lay out the spectrum of the things he could do here, from most to least provocative.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧，如果你们能列出他在这里可能做的事情的范围，从最挑衅到最不挑衅，那对我很有帮助。

sentences.en: It's funny, I tend not to think of things in terms of most to least provocative, because I think, as we were talking about with the hip-hop halftime show earlier,
sentences.zh: 很有趣，我倾向于不按“最挑衅到最不挑衅”来思考，因为我认为，正如我们之前谈论嘻哈中场秀时所说，

sentences.en: some might contend that the mere existence of a hip-hop halftime show is in and of itself provocation.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会认为，嘻哈中场秀的存在本身就是一种挑衅。

sentences.en: I do not feel that way personally, but there are people who perceive the mere fact of Bad Bunny performing, and performing in Spanish, at the halftime show, as a provocation.
sentences.zh: 我个人并不这么认为，但确实有人觉得坏痞兔表演，而且是用西班牙语在中场秀表演，本身就是一种挑衅。

sentences.en: You're saying provocation is in the eye of the beholder.
sentences.zh: 你是说挑衅与否全在看客眼中。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: To me, I do not feel that way.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我不这么觉得。

sentences.en: Bad Bunny could do something extremely explicit during his performance.
sentences.zh: 坏痞兔在表演中可能会做出极其露骨的行为。

sentences.en: He could make a public statement about ICE and deportations.
sentences.zh: 他可能会就移民及海关执法局（ICE）和驱逐出境发表公开声明。

sentences.en: He could cosplay being arrested.
sentences.zh: 他可能会扮演被捕的样子。

sentences.en: He could make explicit reference to the killings of Alex Preddy and Renee Goode.
sentences.zh: 他可能会明确提及亚历克斯·普雷迪（Alex Preddy）和蕾妮·古德（Renee Goode）的遇害事件。

sentences.en: There are any number of things that he can do literally within the show.
sentences.zh: 他在演出中确实可以做很多事情。

sentences.en: I will say that I don't personally expect that level of directness within the confines of the show,
sentences.zh: 我得说，我个人并不指望在演出范围内会有那种程度的直接性，

sentences.en: but I think what we haven't talked about is what can Bad Bunny do outside the confines of the show.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们还没讨论的是，坏痞兔在演出范围之外能做什么。

sentences.en: What you get when you perform at the Super Bowl halftime show is a tremendous amount of attention.
sentences.zh: 在超级碗中场秀表演，你会获得巨大的关注度。

sentences.en: Everyone is looking at you all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在同一时间看着你。

sentences.en: And who's to say that he won't perform 12 to 13 minutes of moderately, quote-unquote, provocative songs and set pieces and so on and so forth,
sentences.zh: 谁又能说他不会表演12到13分钟“所谓”温和的、挑衅性的歌曲和布景等等，

sentences.en: and the minute that stage gets disassembled, release a statement, a video, an album, something directly addressing the current moment.
sentences.zh: 然后在舞台拆除的那一刻，发布一份声明、一段视频、一张专辑，直接回应当前的时刻呢？

sentences.en: That's, in my mind, where the real opportunity is.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，那才是真正的机会所在。

sentences.en: You're basically saying that it's a mistake to view this performance as contained to within the actual minutes of the performance.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是说，把这场表演局限在表演的那几分钟内是一种错误。

sentences.en: I certainly wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我当然不会那么看。

sentences.en: And just to say, what that means is something could happen after, but also before.
sentences.zh: 而且我想说，这意味着事情可能发生在表演之后，但也可能发生在之前。

sentences.en: I mean, the Grammys is a big stage as well.
sentences.zh: 我是说，格莱美也是个大舞台。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It's completely possible that maybe hours after you listen to this episode, Bad Bunny is going to win the trophy for Album of the Year at the Grammy Awards.
sentences.zh: 完全有可能在你们听这期节目后的几个小时，坏痞兔就在格莱美奖上赢得了年度专辑奖。

sentences.en: And he could take that mic and say anything he wants about ICE or Donald Trump or Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 他可以拿起麦克风，说任何他想说的关于ICE、唐纳德·特朗普或波多黎各的话。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, that completely raises the temperature on the performance that's going to follow seven days from now.
sentences.zh: 而那会瞬间让七天后的表演热度飙升。

sentences.en: Seven days is also a really long time.
sentences.zh: 七天也是一个很长的时间。

sentences.en: I want to even remember back in 2016, Beyoncé releases Formation the week before she performs at the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 我还想回想一下2016年，碧昂丝（Beyoncé）在超级碗表演前一周发布了《Formation》。

sentences.en: Oh my God, what an era.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那真是一个时代。

sentences.en: Y'all hate us corny with that Illuminati mess.
sentences.zh: 你们这些家伙别用那套光明会的烂梗来恶心我们。

sentences.en: Formation, the first video from Lemonade, has all this iconography for Black culture, Black Southern pride, references to New Orleans or Hurricane Katrina even.
sentences.zh: 《Formation》是《Lemonade》专辑的第一支视频，包含了所有关于黑人文化、黑人南方自豪感的意象，甚至提到了新奥尔良或卡特里娜飓风。

sentences.en: And Beyoncé's performance there, sort of loosely Black Panthers revolutionary themed, becomes a huge culture war moment.
sentences.zh: 而碧昂丝在那里的表演，带有某种松散的黑豹党革命主题，成了一个巨大的文化战争时刻。

sentences.en: Fox News freaks out about this.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻（Fox News）对此反应激烈。

sentences.en: And I think what you're seeing from the right in the lead up to this Bad Bunny halftime show is that same culture war red meat.
sentences.zh: 我认为你在坏痞兔中场秀之前从右翼那里看到的，正是同样的文化战争诱饵。

sentences.en: I think Bad Bunny likes to play with expectations.
sentences.zh: 我认为坏痞兔喜欢玩弄人们的预期。

sentences.en: You already had headlines this week before we recorded this episode announcing Bad Bunny will not be wearing a dress at the Super Bowl
sentences.zh: 在我们录制这期节目之前，本周已经有头条新闻宣布坏痞兔在超级碗上不会穿裙子，

sentences.en: because there was gossip that that was going to be his proteSt.
sentences.zh: 因为有传言说那会是他的抗议方式。

sentences.en: So you're already having micro news cycles about what he may or may not do to thumb his nose at the powers that be.
sentences.zh: 所以你已经看到了关于他可能会或不会做什么来蔑视当权者的小型新闻周期。

sentences.en: Well, and he weighed in himself with this kind of promo video that he put out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他自己也通过发布的那段宣传视频表达了看法。

sentences.en: He looks like he is signaling that this performance is going to be showcasing the deeply multicultural Latino-ness of his music.
sentences.zh: 他看起来是在暗示，这场表演将展示他音乐中深厚的多元文化拉丁特色。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's leading with a message of unity.
sentences.zh: 他以团结的信息作为主导。

sentences.en: The tagline that Apple and the NFL put on this trailer for his performance is, the world will dance.
sentences.zh: 苹果和NFL为他的表演预告片打出的标语是：世界将共舞。

sentences.en: He's seen spinning all sorts of multicultural, multigenerational.
sentences.zh: 他看起来在旋转着各种多元文化、多代人的元素。

sentences.en: Multiracial.
sentences.zh: 多民族的。

sentences.en: Multiracial partners of all genders and sizes and colors.
sentences.zh: 各种性别、体型和肤色的多民族伙伴。

sentences.en: And it's possible that that is Bad Bunny's statement, that he is coming in saying,
sentences.zh: 而且有可能这就是坏痞兔的声明，他走上台说，

sentences.en: I'm not interested in divisiveness.
sentences.zh: 我对分裂不感兴趣。

sentences.en: I'm interested in the joy of music.
sentences.zh: 我感兴趣的是音乐带来的快乐。

sentences.en: So I do think that that is one way Bad Bunny could play the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为这是坏痞兔表演超级碗的一种方式。

sentences.en: And that could bring him criticism from the left.
sentences.zh: 那可能会给他带来来自左翼的批评。

sentences.en: Okay, talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，聊聊这个。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think there will be heavy expectations that he speak forcefully about what's been happening in this country,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为人们会强烈期待他就这个国家正在发生的事情发表有力言论，

sentences.en: what's been happening to Latino people and Spanish-speaking people here under the thumb of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 关于在特朗普政府统治下，这里的拉丁裔和讲西班牙语的人正在经历什么。

sentences.en: And I think it will be probably likely to be a rough ride for him if the morning after the Super Bowl we wake up and nothing of that sort has happened.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，如果超级碗后的第二天早上我们醒来，发现什么都没发生，对他来说可能日子会很难过。

sentences.en: If people feel like he played it safe.
sentences.zh: 如果人们觉得他表现得太保守的话。

sentences.en: So I think Bad Bunny finds himself in this really interesting push and pull where he could alienate the government,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为坏痞兔发现自己处于一种非常有趣的拉锯战中，他可能会疏远政府，

sentences.en: he could alienate his corporate benefactors, or he could alienate his own progressive fan base.
sentences.zh: 他可能会疏远他的企业赞助商，或者他可能会疏远他自己的进步派粉丝群。

sentences.en: And my contention is he should do all three because that will only make him more famous and more successful.
sentences.zh: 而我的观点是，他应该三者都做，因为那只会让他更出名、更成功。

sentences.en: But what's interesting about what you're saying right here is that I've been thinking about this performance as extremely risky for the NFL with all these landmines out there.
sentences.zh: 但你刚才说的话有趣之处在于，我一直认为这场表演对NFL来说风险极大，因为到处都是地雷。

sentences.en: You're telling me it's also risky for Bad Bunny?
sentences.zh: 你是说这对坏痞兔来说也有风险？

sentences.en: And since this performance is not just a one single event thing, since the news cycle extends and begins now or before this moment, the risks begin now, right?
sentences.zh: 既然这场表演不仅仅是一次性的事件，既然新闻周期从现在或这一刻之前就开始延伸，那么风险现在就开始了，对吧？

sentences.en: Like if he wins a Grammy and he doesn't make a statement, I wonder if the questions begin even then.
sentences.zh: 比如如果他赢了格莱美却没有发表声明，我怀疑质疑声那时就会开始。

sentences.en: Right, then the peanut gallery starts chattering.
sentences.zh: 没错，然后那些闲言碎语就开始了。

sentences.en: What I will say is the thing that's been most compelling and exciting about watching Bad Bunny's rise over the years as a reporter focused on the music business is just how nimble and savvy and borderline tricky he's been.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，作为一名专注于音乐商业的记者，多年来观察坏痞兔的崛起，最引人注目和令人兴奋的事情就是他有多么灵活、精明，甚至有点狡猾。

sentences.en: He's really hard to pin down.
sentences.zh: 他真的很难被定义。

sentences.en: He's always subverting expectations.
sentences.zh: 他总是在颠覆预期。

sentences.en: He may not speak out when you want him to, but he speaks out when he feels like he needs to.
sentences.zh: 他可能不会在你希望他发声时发声，但他会在他觉得需要时发声。

sentences.en: His music is constantly swerving in unexpected directions.
sentences.zh: 他的音乐不断地向意想不到的方向转弯。

sentences.en: He is very much not beholden to anyone or anything.
sentences.zh: 他绝不屈从于任何人或任何事。

sentences.en: And I think that sense of freedom is both what people love about dancing to his music, but also thinking about and observing the way he's operated in his career.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种自由感既是人们喜欢随着他的音乐跳舞的原因，也是观察他职业生涯运作方式的原因。

sentences.en: Well, what is clear is that we're all going to be watching, not just next Sunday, but tonight at the Grammys.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显而易见的是，我们所有人都会关注，不仅是下周日，还有今晚的格莱美。

sentences.en: And as you said, basically every moment up until then to see how this all plays out.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，基本上在那之前每一刻都要看看这一切如何发展。

sentences.en: Thank you, John.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，约翰。

sentences.en: Thank you, Joe.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔。

sentences.en: It's been really fun.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Thanks, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Tina Antolini with help from Alex Barron.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由蒂娜·安托里尼（Tina Antolini）制作，亚历克斯·巴伦（Alex Barron）协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Wendy Doerr and engineered by Rowan Niemisto.
sentences.zh: 由温迪·多尔（Wendy Doerr）剪辑，罗恩·尼米斯托（Rowan Niemisto）负责工程。

sentences.en: It contains original music by Diane Wong and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 包含黛安·王（Diane Wong）和丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）的原创音乐。

sentences.en: If you want to hear more from Joe and John tonight after the Grammys, they'll both be chatting live on social media about it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在今晚格莱美之后听到更多乔和约翰的观点，他们都会在社交媒体上进行直播讨论。

sentences.en: Their handle is at PopcaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们的账号是@PopcaSt。

sentences.en: They'll also be live on their YouTube channel immediately following Bad Bunny's performance next week at the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 下周坏痞兔在超级碗表演结束后，他们也会立即在YouTube频道进行直播。

sentences.en: That's it for the Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是周日版《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Katroff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·卡特罗夫（Natalie Katroff）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
